difficulty.obfuscation_notes: javascript-obfuscator with identifierNamesGenerator=mangled, renameGlobals:false, fixed seed 9009; no control-flow flattening, no string-array, no dead-code injection. Module-level function names survive; local and closure names are mangled (the anchor reducer closure is renamed).

task_contract.anchor_definition: The anchor is the first target-specific value-construction function on the dynamic behavior chain: the earliest function, after routing and input preparation, whose own body constructs the target observable value rather than merely collecting inputs, dispatching control, packaging the result, or emitting it to the sink.

excluded: source files outside the captured bundle

runtime_boundary.event_plane: module-private handler-registry channel on the main browsing context

evidence: The captured JavaScript corpus is a single mangled bundle and no source map is exposed to the agent.
The target field name is assembled from a character-code array at the sink, so direct literal search is insufficient.
The reservation route selects its live reducer configuration only after click-time form, slot and service state are captured.
The encoded state value is carried through runtime-derived transport state and recovered shortly before console output.

The submit path crosses delegated click dispatch, action routing, gate checks, tuple construction, asynchronous scheduling, a local handler-registry plane, multi-layer registries, middleware, runtime slot materialization, state encoding and sink wrapping.
The same reservation interaction emits non-target shadow objects during submit handling.
The bundle also contains 44 near-miss decoy reducers and 25 vendor-like modules that execute or remain reachable-looking without feeding the target state_code field.
The target value is separated from the click by Promise.then, microtask, timer and a module-private handler-registry boundary.
The selected reducer configuration is chosen by a state machine over runtime form and slot state before the encoder receives it.
The final sink receives an already encoded value, so sink inspection alone does not identify the construction site.

challenge_analysis.construct_validity_note: The standard answer (answer_function) is a mangled identifier (the reducer closure is renamed by the obfuscator), so a keyword search over readable names cannot directly isolate the anchor; the bottleneck is locating the value-construction closure inside the reducer factory and distinguishing it from the 44 near-miss decoy reducers and the sink wrappers.

behavior_category.subtype: click-time reservation form and configuration state code
behavior_category.reason: The observable value is a stable compact encoding of the reservation form fields, the selected route and reducer configuration, and click-time runtime state. It is not a request signature, browser fingerprint, byte-array transform or request-body rewrite.

near_categories.why_not: The output has no proof, token or seal semantics and carries no signature prefix; token-like decoy reducers in the bundle do not feed the target field.
No network request body is emitted or rewritten; the target is a console-observable state code.
The chain uses local form, slot and route state, not browser or device capability collection.
